scope: Proposition 5.3 of the manuscript “Polynomial Hitting Lists for Noncommutative Rational Formulas” (preprints/Polynomial-Hitting-Lists-for-Noncommutative-Rational-Formulas-September-24-2026/Polynomial-Hitting-Lists-for-Noncommutative-Rational-Formulas-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 116 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8f6fe5057bd59278), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The list Hn,s can be constructed and written by one deterministic Turing machine in a number of bit operations bounded by a fixed polynomial in n + s + 1. Its entire binary encoding has length bounded by a fixed polynomial in the same quantity.
